QuestInfo.name: Schegerazade's Third Riddle
QuestInfo.0: Only the last riddle remained! Schegerazade was ready to tell it to Alpha and Beta.
QuestInfo.1: Schegerazade's final question was for Alpha and Beta to bring her #bthe thing she wanted most#k in the entire world. This one seemed impossible, but Alpha and Beta decided to ask around.
QuestInfo.2: Schegerazade's final question, the thing that Schegerazade wanted the most her little brother Jiyur. You were not able to bring Jiyur back to the palace but you were able to deliver the Jiyur's letter to Schedgerazade and she was happy to give you credit for the correct answer.

speech.0: Obviously what Schegerazade wants the most is my affection! A fairy's attention is what all humans want!
What Schegerazade wants? Hmm... She's already got royal food and pretty clothes... I'm not sure what else she would want.  Maybe #bJiyur#k would know. Schegerazade is his sister!
